shots.purpose: State the point while six real films play
shots.action: Six real films play as prints on the bench; the camera pulls back from one to the whole wall while the orange tape runs under them

narration.zh: motion-use 让 coding agent 当导演：写代码出片，在本地渲染，再自己检查成片。
narration.en: motion-use lets your coding agent direct a film: it writes it as code, renders it locally, then checks the result.

shots.purpose: Show that a film is a small text file
shots.action: The tape leads to the real draw.js beside the iPhone promo it renders; the time counter scrubs and the picture follows; the byte counts roll up against the MP4 size

narration.zh: 每一帧都是时间的函数。这支 55 秒的示例，源码只有 26 KB，agent 改代码，不用拖时间线。
narration.en: Each frame is a function of time. This 55-second example is just 26 kilobytes. The agent edits code, not a timeline.

shots.holdReason: Narration needs the time; the picture keeps changing inside the shot.

shots.purpose: Show that films do not share one template
shots.action: Four prints with four unrelated looks slide into a row and each gets its label

narration.zh: 画风每次重新设计：毛毡、白板、数据图，互不相像。
narration.en: Each film gets a look of its own: felt 3D, whiteboard, charts.

shots.purpose: Show the delivered MP4 being measured
shots.action: The real verify output types into a terminal; each motion light turns green as its line lands

narration.zh: 本地渲染完，它把成片解码一遍：动得够不够、响度、有没有黑场，都量出来。
narration.en: It renders on your machine, then decodes the whole MP4 and measures it: motion, loudness, blank frames.

shots.holdReason: Narration needs the time; the picture keeps changing inside the shot.

shots.action: A real still --guides frame rises; the red platform zones sweep in around the safe box

narration.zh: 竖版会标出平台按钮挡住的区域，字和重点都避开它。
narration.en: For vertical video it marks what the platform's buttons cover, and keeps the words clear.

shots.purpose: Show two real defects the checks now catch
shots.action: The real clipped callout from the last film gets an orange box at the frame edge, then flips to the fixed frame; beside it the misread narration line is struck and corrected

narration.zh: 上一支片子里，配音念错了字，还有一行标注跑出了画面。现在这两种问题，渲染时就会查出来。
narration.en: In our last film the voice misread a word, and a label ran off the edge. Both now get caught at render time.

shots.holdReason: Narration needs the time; the picture keeps changing inside the shot.

shots.purpose: Show one source becoming four cuts
shots.action: The iPhone promo's four real cuts open out of one print: Chinese and English, landscape and vertical

narration.zh: 一份源码，出中文和英文、横版和竖版，还有各平台用的高画质文件。
narration.en: One source gives you Chinese and English, landscape and vertical, and high-quality masters for every platform.

shots.action: The tape winds into the wordmark; the install command types out and holds
shots.holdReason: Time to read the install command.

narration.en: motion-use. Open source. One command to install.
